v36-man-bed.observed_description: At night a tired man in a grey T-shirt yawns with a hand over his mouth and points at his made bed; the window is dark.

v37-woman-lemons.observed_description: A young woman with curly red hair holds out a white plate with exactly three yellow lemons in a kitchen.

v38-soup-mushroom-onion.observed_description: A white bowl of clear soup with slices of white mushroom and rings of onion, nothing else, seen from above.

v39-pass-butter.observed_description: An older woman hands an older man a white dish with a big block of yellow butter across a breakfast table.

v40-man-bill.observed_description: A man with glasses holds his wallet open and raises a hand at a cafe table with an empty plate and cup.

v41-woman-fork-knife.observed_description: A woman with long black braids holds up a fork in one hand and a table knife in the other over a plate of food.

v42-lemonade-offer.observed_description: A young man in a yellow T-shirt holds out a glass of lemonade; an older woman in a straw hat raises a hand to refuse.

v43-pineapples-lots.observed_description: A market stall counter covered with a huge pile of whole pineapples, far too many to count.
